dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thin pale fringes on the greater and median coverts creating a repetitive, scalloped banding pattern.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale borders on the outer webs of the primary and secondary feathers against dark centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition with low linearity; demarcated by a shift from fine mottling on the crown to larger scaled patterns on the mantle.
